Face impossible dilemmas, meet strange characters, and discover how every switch changes the story. As the trolley keeps moving, your choices will decide who you trust, who you betray, and whether you become someone you never meant to be.

Meet 30+ side characters for you to SAVE! Or, you know... to sacrifice. Some may help you later, some may haunt your journey, and some may only exist to test what kind of person you really are.

Depending on who you are fighting against and who stands on your side, each fight can turn into a different kind of challenge.

There is no single right way to play. Side with outlaws, trust the scientists, protect your conscience, or chase power at any cost. In the end, Trolley Dilemma is not only about who lives or dies. It is about what your choices turn you into.

Trailer music: "Hall of the Mountain King" by Kevin MacLeod , licensed under CC BY 4.0

The sun rises. Humid air hangs over your fields.
What starts as a small plantation can become the heart of an entire industry.

Tropic Industry takes you to where it all begins: the source of raw materials.
Here, it’s not about how much you grow — it’s about what you turn it into.

From Plantation to Industry

You begin with a small plantation on a tropical island.
Step by step, you expand it into a complex production system of cultivation, processing, and export.

Coffee, cocoa, sugarcane, bananas, tobacco, cotton, vanilla —
everything grows under your control.

But raw materials alone have little value.
Real industry begins with processing.

Build Real Production Lines

Construct specialized buildings and connect them into efficient chains:

  • Plantations — large-scale, efficient, specialized

  • Processing facilities — fermenters, roasters, presses

  • Storage and logistics systems

Optimize routes, reduce downtime, and keep your production running.
Downtime costs money. Efficiency drives growth.

Think Like an Entrepreneur

This is not a traditional farming game.

  • Scale what works

  • Replace what slows you down

  • Respond to demand

  • Build a stable export economy

You won’t master everything at once.
And that’s where the challenge lies.

Features

  • Focus on plantation industry rather than traditional farming

  • Multi-stage production chains with clear progression

  • Diverse tropical resources with unique processing paths

  • Build and optimize complex industrial systems

  • Logistics and resource flow as core mechanics

  • Grow from a small operation into a full-scale industry

Your Goal

Turn a simple plantation into a powerful industrial operation.

Expand your production, refine your processes, and build a system that grows — and endures.

Geum Gyuri is the daughter of a kumquat farmer on Jeju Island.
She transfers on scholarship to Shinseon High School, an elite academy attended by the heirs of Korea’s most prestigious fruit families.
She has only one goal: remain in the top-ranked S Class and make it safely to graduation.

But on her very first day, two people she never expected to meet step into her life.
The school’s beloved idol, Shin Melon, and the prickly rebel, Shin Lemon.
As Gyuri becomes entangled with the polar-opposite twins, her new school life seems to take on a bright, kumquat-colored glow...

But something about this school isn’t quite as “fresh” as it seems.
What “rotten” truth will Gyuri uncover beneath its “fresh” facade?

  • Colorful pixel-art character sprites, backgrounds, and CGs, with select animated sequences

  • A story that delves into the characters’ inner lives, relationships, and the dark secrets they hide

  • One overarching main story with three different endings

  • Simple point-and-click elements that let you interact directly with story events

  • Playtime: Approximately 4–5 hours

  • Available in Korean, English, and Japanese

Get rich or die trying! You are free to agree with El Presidente – on the greatness of Tropico and his unmatched leadership skills. In Tropico 7, you step into his shiny boots again to build your archipelago nation and – literally – move mountains.

With great power comes great responsibility – and even greater opportunity. As the most benevolent leader of your island nation, guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity. Remember: Control isn’t tyranny, it’s efficiency – and more control means more efficiency (except when Penultimo is involved, but that’s another story).

Exert your control and shape the landscape you are building on to fit your vision. Plan and construct complex city layouts, fulfil the multifaceted needs of your subjects, give precise directions to your army, and look down on your opponents in the council, all while revelling in your own splendour. See how it all leads to ever greater efficiency? This could be an aspiring dictator’s dream come true indeed… however, sometimes life gives you lemons. Or obstacles in the shape of a very clever and very annoying opponent: Victoria Guerra! You will need all your skills, cunning and presidential ‘grandeur’ to end this latest chapter with a simple truth: ¡Victoria no es la revolución!

  • Lead your nation to new heights: Tropico 7 tells El Presidente’s continuous success story across 5 campaign maps – starring himself, Penultimo and a new nemesis: Victoria Guerra.

  • More is more: Archipelagos, with the biggest islands ever in the series, await your rule, expanded with 10 extra scenarios, more than 20 sandbox maps, and endless possibilities with a random map generator.

  • Move mountains – literally: Erase them, create beaches, or even create entirely new islands! The new terraforming feature brings your megalomaniac dreams to life. Start that mammoth project – NOW!

  • Bollocks uhm… Politics: Navigate the snares and pits of internal politics, when you summon the different factions to your council, a new way to meet them face to face while you pulverize their dreams – or use them for a BIG DEAL to your own advantage.

  • Make the world your playground: Elections, election speeches and a vast portfolio of edicts depending on your political standing spice up your daily rule while you juggle foreign affairs and occasionally steal... uhm relocate a landmark to revel in its benefits.

  • Built to prosper: Strategically place buildings to make use of synergy effects, keep citizen satisfaction high, and fill any unused plots of land with beautiful parks in a freely customized size.

  • Generalissimo No. 1: Eliminate those pesky rebels and fend off foreign threats with a reworked military system enabling more direct control of your military units.

  • Always judge a book by its cover: Customize the appearance of your palace and El Presidente with new and creative options.

Potion High

Something went terribly wrong at Potion High. The school fell into the "Non-Dimension" and was placed under strict quarantine. Those who remained within its walls are trapped outside of time and space. If no one does anything about it, they will be stuck here for years. Possibly forever.

Everyone around takes me for just another disoriented student... and let's keep it that way for now.

It's time to take matters into my own hands. Just me and the Non-Dimension – equal opponents.

"Your wits are your weapon, expect the unexpected, be prepared for anything, and nothing will surprise you," Hieronim used to repeat. I wonder if he was surprised in his final moments, or if he expected the end... Doesn't matter.

This is a narrative game focused on story, distinct characters, and humor. Gameplay relies on exploring the world at your own pace, engaging in dialogues, and progressing the plot without frustrating roadblocks.

Key features:

  • Deceptively Stylized Visuals: A hand-painted, cartoon-inspired art style that creates a striking, unsettling contrast with the game's dark and serious narrative.

  • Narrative Walking Simulator: Step into the role of an observer. Wander through the atmospheric, Victorian-style corridors, eavesdropping on strange conversations to piece together the grim truth.

  • Minimalist Immersion: Focus purely on the story and atmosphere. Your journey is about exploration rather than complex mechanics—you simply walk, occasionally manipulating key objects, and experience brief, unnerving encounters with monsters.

  • A Dark, Weird Tale: A dense, linear storyline that trades comedy for a touch of horror and surrealism, set in a world that has slipped completely out of its dimension.

Different trucks!

As Trucker Joe, you build up your own freight company. You start with an old, weak truck, but later on, with your hard-earned money, you can buy some seriously cool rigs!

You place the companies on the map!

You should strategically consider where to place each company to avoid unnecessary detours.

Different companies require specialized trailers!

Every type of cargo needs the right trailer! Whether it's delivering heavy construction equipment or frozen pizza, you’ll need the right trailer for the job.

THE PHONE RANG AFTER TWELVE YEARS IN A BOX

Haru is spending the last week of summer at grandma's house in Wasure-machi — «the Forgotten Town». In the storeroom, inside a cardboard box, an old yellow flip phone switches itself on. Inside it lives Denpa: a sarcastic AI stuck forever at 4% battery, and the only thing in the world that can see tsukumogami — the spirits that grow inside objects people stopped caring about.

The umbrella grandma lost in 1987 has been waiting on the stairs the whole time. It is thrilled to see you.

POINT. FOCUS. SNAP.

Raise the TsukuLens and the town turns violet. Something is breathing inside that bush, under that vending machine, behind that shutter. Hold your breath, frame it, take the photo — a good shot earns you a friend, a bad shot earns you a blurry thumb and a spirit that is now annoyed.

161 SPIRITS, AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS NORMAL

A raincoat that never dried. A stapler that appointed itself a judge. A vending machine with strong opinions about loyalty. Every spirit has a tribe, a personality (shy, cocky, sleepyhead…), a favourite snack and a bond that grows when you feed it.

THE WHEEL

Six friends on a spinning wheel: three at the front fighting, three at the back catching their breath. Spin to rotate, aim with the camera, purify the cursed, throw snacks, and when the gauge fills — pull the trigger on a Burst and hit the rhythm.

A TOWN THAT LIVES ON YOUR CLOCK

The calendar inside the game is your calendar. Festivals arrive when they arrive. A full moon is a full moon. The boss of the week rotates every real Monday, and the ghost bus only stops on Tuesdays — at places that do not exist.

WHAT ELSE IS IN THERE

  • 14 places: the town, a hot spring, a beach festival, a neon city, a landfill kingdom, a school at midnight, an abandoned hospital, the sewers, a dead train tunnel, the spirit back-alley, and the same town in 1987.

  • The Tsukumo League: eight rivals scattered across the world, and a tournament that will humble you.

  • The Tower of the Forgotten: 50 floors, random modifiers, no mercy.

  • Fishing, gachapon, karaoke duels, menko, cooking, a bug net, an onsen, a TV channel, rumours, photo quests and a free photo mode with filters, stickers and frames.

  • Your own room to decorate with everything you drag home, and your photos framed on the wall.

  • Two-player co-op where the second player is Denpa: a cursor that marks targets and throws snacks.

THE TONE

Warm, silly and occasionally sad, in the way that only a story about things people threw away can be. Denpa will insult you. You will grow fond of a stapler. Around chapter six you may need a moment.

Isekai Games

An SQL course that likes you back.

TsundereSQL is an SQL course inside an anime visual novel. You type SQL into a query editor, run it on DuckDB and see the rows come back. When you submit, the story moves on only if your query also gives the right answer on data you have not seen. Most of your time is spent writing queries; the story scenes come between problems.

You start at your first SELECT and work through 224 problems across 14 modules, up to window functions, cohorts and production-style data with messy dates, NULLs and duplicates. Three instructors teach the modules, and each one warms up to you as you improve.





Of the 224 problems, 220 are SQL exercises. The other four are analyst-judgment cases, where you write the decision and your reasoning instead of a query.

  • SQL Foundations and Aggregation & GROUP BY: pull the rows you need and get totals and rates you can trust.
  • Joins & Set Operations: combine tables without quietly doubling your numbers.
  • Subqueries & CTEs: break a hard question into steps you can read back.
  • Window Functions: rankings, running totals, QUALIFY, gaps and islands, sessions.
  • Product & Growth Analytics: retention, cohorts, funnels and experiment questions.
  • Advanced SQL: recursion, JSON, reshaping, data at scale and data modeling.
  • Working With Production Data: dates, NULLs, casts, messy JSON and records that disagree.
  • Thinking Like a Senior Analyst, the Growth Desk and the Interview Gauntlet: longer business questions, interview-style problems and the four judgment cases.



If you already write SQL, take the placement exam on the Module 1 page: six problems, no hints, and a pass skips you past up to three modules. If you are starting from zero, start at the top and let the difficulty climb with you.





Three instructors teach the course. Tsumugi is demanding, Aimi is patient, and Nora is precise to a fault. Each has her own fixed route with its own scenes and ending, and you unlock those scenes by solving problems. Romance is optional and can be switched off.







Every SQL exercise is checked on two to four hidden datasets as well as the one you can see, so a query that only fits the sample does not pass. When your answer is wrong on the sample you can see, the game shows your rows next to the expected ones, with the missing and extra rows marked.







Tsumugi: SQL Foundations, and the placement exam that lets you skip the first three modules if you already know them. She will tell you the query is fine, and then tell you what is wrong with it.

Nora: joins, window functions, and the Growth Desk where the question is money. With Nora, "it works" is where the conversation starts.

Aimi: she keeps your record, every solve and every miss, and runs the review rounds that bring back problems you solved, on fresh data.

Good to know

  • English only. All story and course text is in English.
  • Windows 10 or 11, keyboard and mouse. No controller support.
  • Plays offline once installed. The optional tutor needs an internet connection.
  • The story deals with grief, memory loss and unreality.
  • The free demo is all of Module 1, so you can try the course before you buy.



The game includes optional romance storylines and optional suggestive anime artwork (including swimwear or other revealing, non-nude outfits). On first launch, before the game starts, a content screen that previews both art settings requires an affirmative adult confirmation to continue with suggestive artwork, or offers a one-click route that disables it. Suggestive artwork is otherwise on by default after confirmation and can be disabled later in Settings. Romance is enabled by default and can be disabled separately. There is no nudity and no explicit sexual content.

TuanBot brings a cast of charming companions to your desktop. In this free demo, create your own Tuanbots, discover little stories in Tuan House, interact with the chatty flower Feihuahua, and link supported Agent tools to view quotas and manage accounts.

Create your own Tuanbot


Customize a character’s appearance, choose a name, and set their personality to make your desktop companion your own. The demo supports up to 3 Tuanbots.

A glimpse of life in Tuan House


Your companions have lives of their own. Watch their interactions in Tuan House and discover little stories between them, adding a cheerful break to your day.

A little nonsense with Feihuahua


Click this talkative little flower to hear her playful remarks. She can also gather your companions and announce the time at selected hours, bringing small surprises to your routine.

Link Agent tools, view quotas, and manage accounts


Link supported Agent tools to check quota information and manage or switch accounts. See the app for supported tools and available information.

About this demo


This demo focuses on character customization, Tuan House stories, Feihuahua interactions, and Agent tool linking, quota viewing, and account management. AI chat is not included. Tuan Island and some other features are not yet available.

The demo contains no purchases, top-ups, or subscriptions. Linked Agent tools are subject to their respective services’ usage requirements and quota rules.

Your next adventure awaits

Grab your innertube and explore a colorful island world in Tubular Tides. Travel between islands, get to know their inhabitants, and follow clues, quests, and distractions you'll discover along the way.

Find your next favorite shore

Take to the water and explore islands with their own personalities. Venture inland, and investigate interesting and intriguing landmarks, and keep an eye out for hidden medallions and treasure.

Follow your curiosity

Chase a treasure lead, search for another collectible, or head toward a shore you haven't visited. There's always another reason to set sail with your innertube.

Explore the tales of the lost

These islands have stories of their own, beyond what the inhabitants tell. Curious landmarks, ancient traces and passing remarks hint that there's something more to this world waiting to be pieced together. Keep your eyes open, you may find more than just treasure.

Tumble Tavern is Farkle at a tavern table, with enchanted runes that can turn a losing throw around.

Throw six dice and set aside the ones that score. Then bank your points, or throw the rest for more. A throw that scores nothing is a Ruin, and everything you collected that turn is gone. Banked points are safe. First to the target score wins.

  • 18 enchanted runestones. Carry three into every match and cast them when the throw needs it.
  • 9 kinds of dice. Build a six-die loadout. Each kind pays its bonus its own way.
  • 12 tavern regulars with habits instead of difficulty levels. Read how each one plays and take the table back.
  • A roguelite gauntlet. Rivals one after another, winnings climb with the streak, and one loss ends the run.
  • Two players, one table. Pass the dice in Local Duel, or invite a friend online with Remote Play Together.
  • Full controller support, Windows and SteamOS/Linux, and ten languages.

Dice

You bring six dice to a match, chosen from nine kinds. Each kind pays a scoring bonus under its own condition, and the bonus is paid for every die of that kind you are holding. Ember pays a flat bonus on any scoring hold. Tide pays when you hold three or more dice. Void pays only on holds of 750 or more. Because the bonus stacks per die, six of one kind plays very differently from a spread of six.

Runes

You carry three runestones from a set of 18, and cast them during the match. Aegis shields your turn, so a Ruin breaks the shield and you throw again. Fortune adds 100 to the next set you hold. Longshot bets the turn on a face you name. You cannot swap them mid-match, so the three you bring shape how you play.

Rivals

Twelve tavern regulars, each with a fixed habit rather than a difficulty level. One banks the moment he is ahead, however little he holds. Another rolls on long after anyone sensible would stop. Once you have read a rival's habit, you can play against it.

Modes

Quick Wager. Four tables, Friendly through Gold, each with its own rival. One match, one stake.

Endless Gauntlet. Rivals one after another. Difficulty and winnings climb with the streak, and a loss ends the run.

Campaign. Twelve fights in order, each built around a specific problem.

Local Duel. Two players at one screen, taking turns.

Free demo: the first two campaign fights and the Friendly and Copper tables.

Luna wakes up in an unfamiliar base.

Inside, life is peaceful. She eats, sorts her gear, and prepares for the next expedition. Outside, however, abandoned facilities, forgotten belongings, and dangerous creatures await.

TunaSweeper is a top-down PvE looter shooter that alternates between peaceful life at the base and dangerous expeditions into the outside world.

Head Out, Loot, and Make It Back

Explore different areas outside the base, search for useful supplies, and fight off enemies along the way.

Choose what equipment to bring before heading out, then decide what is worth taking home once you're in the field. You can risk staying longer to fill your inventory, or return early to protect what you've already found.

What you bring, what you take, and when you decide to head back all matter.

Life Goes On Back at the Base

Make it home safely, sort through what you've collected, and prepare for your next expedition.

Spend time with the others who live at the base, or simply take a moment to rest. Unlike the dangerous world outside, life at the base moves at a quiet, relaxed pace.

Combat and exploration are only part of TunaSweeper. Making it home safely and returning to everyday life is just as important.

Discover the World at Your Own Pace

The game won't tell you everything about this world or what happened to it from the start.

Old facilities, strange machinery, forgotten objects, and subtle changes in your surroundings gradually reveal more about the world as Luna explores it.

Key Features

  • Top-down PvE shooting combat

  • Exploration, looting, and inventory management

  • Venture into dangerous areas and return safely to your base

  • Peaceful everyday life between expeditions

  • Cute, stylized 3D visuals

  • A world that gradually reveals itself through exploration and environmental details

You rent a shabby laundromat on the corner of a quiet city block. By day it washes other people's shirts. By night, behind a sheet of plywood in the basement, you dig. Shop by shop, under the street, toward the vault of First City Bank.

DIG BY NIGHT


A shovel, a sack and thirteen minutes of darkness. Every strike takes a real bite out of the ground: soil, clay, old brick, buried sewers and rock, each with its own tool and its own noise. The tunnel you dig is the tunnel you keep, night after night.

THE DIRT HAS TO GO SOMEWHERE


Every metre of tunnel is a pile of earth that can't be seen. Bag it, wheel it, lay rails and push a mine cart down your own tunnel, then tip it all down the old coal chute before the garbage truck comes at dawn. Logistics is the real heist.

KEEP THE CEILING UP


Long spans sag. Dust trickles, beams creak, and then it comes down. Build timber frames, read the ground, and learn how far you can push your luck before the street caves in on you.

STAY QUIET


The patrol car cruises past. Marty the landlord drops by to check the boiler, flashlight in hand. Dig when the subway thunders overhead, hang sound foam on the walls, hide the hole before anyone walks in, and keep suspicion low or the police come knocking.

WHAT'S DOWN THERE


The whole block is full of buried things: pocket watches, silver spoons, old coins, fossils, a smuggler's tin box, and rare finds that come out of the wall in a burst of light. Sweep the ground radar and watch them glow through the earth. Sell to the fence, complete relic collections, and follow the mystery under the block.

GET BETTER EVERY NIGHT


Every morning, spend what you found on better tools and permanent upgrades: dig faster, carry more, build stronger, stay quieter, search better, sell higher. Nothing you build is ever lost. A bad night costs you time, never the tunnel.

ONE BLOCK, ONE CONTINUOUS HEIST


No levels, no loading screens between jobs. A pawn shop, a jeweller, a casino counting room and the bank vault sit side by side under the same street. Each score funds the next, and the tunnel grows with you.

FEATURES


  • Real-time digging in deformable ground, with soil, clay, brick, sewer and rock layers
  • Dirt logistics: bags, wheelbarrow, rails and a mine cart, and the old coal chute
  • Ground radar, metal detector and sound foam: gadgets that change how you dig
  • Structural support with timber frames and cave-ins you can see coming
  • Noise and suspicion: patrols, the landlord, the police and the subway as cover
  • Hundreds of buried finds, relic collections and legendary treasures, plus a mystery buried since 1978
  • Permanent upgrades in six branches; you never lose your tunnel
  • One hand-built city block, one continuous heist from the first shovel to the vault

A chess puzzle game where you play both sides, no opponent, no checkmate. Each level sets its own objectives. Some pieces explode when captured, others freeze or shield the squares around them, and some move right through other pieces. Rewind freely until every objective is met at once.

Command the Chaos.

Bombs detonate when captured. Shields turn attacks away. Freezing auras lock down every square around them. Ghost pieces slide through anything in the way. Fragile squares may crumble when you move, and holes cut off the board entirely. Every level hands you a different set of these, and the solution is always hiding in how they combine.

You control both armies.

There's no opponent. You move white, then black, then white again, alternating sides every turn. Both colors are yours, so capturing your own pieces and making sacrifices no real game would allow is often the whole point.

No chess skill needed.

Pieces move by standard chess rules. There are no kings, no check, and no checkmate. This isn't a match to win, it's a position to solve.

Pick up a piece and every square it can reach lights up, so you never have to remember how a knight moves or which way a pawn takes. Switch the highlights off in the settings whenever you want the harder version.

Every level wants something different.

Some levels want the board cleared to a single piece. Others want a whole color wiped out, a specific pawn promoted, a chosen piece walked to a target square, or a vulnerable piece kept alive to the end. When a level sets several goals, you have to satisfy all of them at the same time.

You can't lose.

Rewind and redo any move instantly. Chase a bad idea, see where it breaks, and step back without penalty. If a position has no legal moves left, you simply rewind. The only way out of a puzzle is to actually solve it.

Features

  • One player, two armies. You move white, then black, then white.

  • Basic chess movement. No kings, no check, no checkmate.

  • Pieces that explode, shield, freeze, or move straight through other pieces.

  • Boards with fragile squares, holes, and portals.

  • Objectives that stack: clear the board, promote a pawn, walk a piece to a square, keep a piece alive, capture in a set order.

  • Rewind and redo as much as you like.

  • 170 levels, all hand-crafted.

Tutsak (Turkish for “captive”) is a co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Explore abandoned places with your friends, complete the objectives and escape alive.

GET CAUGHT, GET LOCKED UP

If the creature catches you, it throws you in a prison cell. Your friends must find the key and break you out before it's too late.

OR SELL OUT A FRIEND

Sometimes the creature offers you a deal: take the cell yourself, or point at a teammate — and it hunts them instead.

IT CAN HEAR YOU

With proximity voice chat, you only hear friends who are nearby. Some creatures hunt by sound, including your voice — and one of them can copy it.

FEATURES

  • Different creatures, each with its own rules

  • Mannequins that only move when no one is looking — with an optional webcam mode where your real blinks count

  • Complete objectives, crack codes and break your friends out of prison

  • End-of-round replay: see where the creature really was

This game includes an optional camera-based blink detection feature. It is disabled by default and can be enabled in settings. No images or video are recorded or transmitted.

Twelve Knots is a story-driven 2D Korean folk horror adventure. Explore, investigate, and uncover what lies beneath familiar places.

Story

On the day of his great-grandfather’s ancestral rite, high school student Seo Do-gyeong sets off for school as usual. As he passes the village’s ancient dangsan tree—a sacred guardian tree—the old brass bell he has carried since childhood rings for the very first time.

From that moment on, the familiar halls of his school begin to twist into something strange. Classrooms emptied of students. An old videotape that should not exist within the school. Announcements calling Do-gyeong by another name. The more desperately he searches for a way home, the further the path leads him away from the school—and toward a village of the dead beyond the dangsan tree.

Gameplay

Ring the brass bell to reveal traces hidden beneath ordinary surroundings. Examine ominous objects, uncover clues, and solve puzzles tied to ancestral rites and forgotten rituals. As Do-gyeong ventures deeper, the buried history of his family slowly comes to light.

Features

Observe and investigate — Examine objects and search your surroundings for clues to your next step.

A bell that reveals hidden traces — Ring an old brass bell to uncover what ordinary surroundings conceal.

Puzzles rooted in rituals — Connect clues and interact with objects to solve puzzles inspired by ancestral rites and forgotten ceremonies.

Supernatural threats — Face unsettling presences and escape through dark corridors. Includes graphic violence, blood, and bodily injury.

【Twilight Tides: Mirage Journey】

The journey begins the moment we meet. You embark on a tarot-driven adventure that will touch love, loss, growth, and regret.

A shattered post-apocalyptic Earth intertwines with the sealed wartime realm of WWII Southeast Asia, two worlds overlapping as one.

Uncover the fate quietly stolen from you. This quest to reclaim yourself stretches long, yet lasts but a fleeting breath of mortal life.

The heroine and six fated heroes traverse the rifts between these twin realities. This journey mirrors life itself: there are no perfect answers, and every choice carves your destiny into being.

Dark Fantasy Tarot × Fateful Choices × Soul Exploration

A shattered, high-tech post-apocalyptic Earth, paired with a parallel-world WWII Nanyang wartime realm. This is a tale of stolen time, love, and tarot fate.

Built upon the 22 Major Arcana, woven from the years of two timelines lies a dark fantasy labyrinth. The cards of your fate wait for you to draw them one by one.

It is a journey, a soul-searching odyssey across time to confront your true self.

Step into unknown realms. Tarot threads together life, death and fate across timelines. Face fated romance and cross-world choices. Engage the gears of destiny deep within your soul — reflecting your views on intimacy and selfhood.

 

Fate never asks whether you are ready.

 

It lays the same question before you, over and over again:

 

Some would break you out of prison for you. Others would burn the world to the ground for you.

 

You say “no choice is inherently right or wrong” — yet every price must be paid by you.

 

This is not a tale of saving the world. It is a dark‑fantasy labyrinth woven from tarot cards.

 

When you reach the end and look back — is the person who drew the very first card at the start still you?

About This Game

Dark‑Fantasy Tarot × Fate‑Driven Choices × Inner‑Self Exploration

 

From the moment you awaken, the table of fate has already been set for you.

 

This is a dark‑fantasy labyrinth built upon the twenty‑two Major Arcana, nourished by the years of two intertwined timelines. Every card of fate waits for you to turn, along with the weight you must bear for every choice you make. More than a simple game journey, this is a profound soul‑searching odyssey across time to confront your true self.

Story Premise

You open your eyes amid nothingness, all memories of past lives erased. A fateful tome, *The Codex of Primal Order*, has quietly chosen you.

 

The twenty‑two tarot cards are shattered fragments of destiny. They thread countless parallel lives and bind six fated souls tied to you by life‑and‑death bonds, love and torment. Your existence is no longer confined to a single path. Two vastly different worlds will present their trials simultaneously, forcing you to make hard choices.

Primary World · Sci‑Fi Apocalypse 

Black holes devour the light of heaven; the earth cracks and collapses. The Earth of the future has long lost all warmth of humanity. Multiple powers stand in rivalry: the United Deep‑Blue Republic, the Firmament Federation, and the Styx Empire. They seem to uphold the last prosperous utopia of the end times.

Yet beneath this glittering facade lies rot and desolation accumulated through ages of apocalypse — countless regrets born of plundered time and shackled fate. The masses dwell in false security. You alone can perceive the truth and stir the course of destiny.

Secondary Timeline · Turbulent WWII‑era Southeast Asia

 

Smoke of war blazes across the sky, human lives are as fragile as grass. This is a cruel world crushed by warfare. The gears of fate are forced into motion, where survival and love collide in their rawest form.

 

Trapped within the chessboard of chaos, every step you take is fraught with peril, each decision a matter of life and death. You must fight to escape amid gunfire and parting grief. Amid utter desolation, you choose whether to become a saving light for another soul. Will you make it out of that era alive?

High odds mean a weak fighter.

UMBRATIO is a management sim about reading the odds board of an illegal fight pit and betting on bouts everyone else has misread. Playing it is not much different from logging into a real illegal betting site: browse the odds, deal with brokers, and put money into your betting slip, all directly through the interface.


Each week, pick a matchup from the newly posted odds that looks ripe for an upset, buy the information and intervention you need to back up that read, place your bet, and watch the fight unfold in real time. Then prepare for the next round.


Fighters with strong records get low odds. Fighters on losing streaks get high odds. The problem is that records never tell the whole story. Some fighters step into the ring while hiding injuries. Others already know a weakness their opponent cannot handle.


Pay a broker and you can get that information before everyone else. Of course, not every tip is true. Whether you trust one source, cross-check it with another broker, or spend more money to verify it is entirely up to you.


If the matchup still is not favorable enough, intervene before the fight. There are people around every fighter who need money, and others with weaknesses they would rather keep hidden. Combine the right approach with the right action, and the fight may already be tilted before either fighter steps into the ring.


You enter this world in debt. At first, survival means scraping by on smaller fights while making repayments every two weeks. If you cannot keep up, you are out.


Use your profits to buy shares in the operation. As your stake grows, so do the money on the line and the information and methods you can access.


And fights here do not end with a win or a loss. Whether the loser lives or is executed, even that final decision has money riding on it.


Read the odds, buy information, and interfere with the outcome when you need to. One day, you may stop being the person placing the bets and become the one shaping the game.

  • Buy information from brokers and cross-check it to separate truth from lies

  • Use broadcast logs to catch revealed information and shifting match variables
  • Manage your cash and debt repayments due every two weeks

Find Your Own Way to Fight


Choose a race, distribute your attributes, and shape your growth through skill trees. Build your approach with melee weapons, bows, firearms, elemental magic, psionics, summons, and defensive abilities, then bring it together with equipment and consumables.

Make your abilities work together: control enemies, create space for ranged attacks, or call on summons to help you fight. Bosses in some areas also grant a powerful Tower Gift, opening new directions for your build during the current run.

Prepare for the Unknown


Step through portals to explore distinct themed areas spanning multiple floors. Handcrafted spaces and procedural layouts bring different routes, traps, enemies, and bosses.

Darkness, visibility, and traps test your judgment; hunger, food, and medicine test your preparation. Complete an area's challenge, return to town to talk, trade, and adjust your equipment, then choose your next portal.

Death ends your current run. Put what you have learned about enemies, the environment, and your build to work as you step through the portals again, searching for a way out of this moonlit world.

Undying Soul is a fast-paced 2D action roguelite where you fight through a brutal world with a roster of unique playable characters.

Different Playable Characters

Carry two characters at a time, each with their own weapons, abilities, stats and playstyles. Swap between them during combat to exploit their strengths, adapt to different situations, and change the flow of a fight. As new characters become available throughout a run, replace your current lineup and discover new combinations.

Create Broken Builds

Collect items, upgrades and relics that interact with your characters and abilities. Experiment with powerful synergies and create builds that can completely change how you play.

Allies Can Become Enemies

The characters you can recruit may also stand in your way. Some can appear as dangerous minibosses, forcing you to fight against their unique abilities and combat styles before they can join your journey.

Face Ancient Guardians

At the end of every chapter, a powerful guardian awaits. Each guardian protects a fragment of your shattered soul and demands a different strategy to overcome. Defeat them all to restore what was lost and bring your shattered soul back together.

YouTuber Junho visits an abandoned factory on the outskirts of the city to film his next video. The place has long been the subject of urban legends.

A camera, a flashlight, a tripod. One night, Junho climbs over the rusted gate. At first, everything goes as planned. Eerie corridors, deserted workbenches, and rooms left untouched.

The footage from that night is never uploaded.

In some scenes, the sound arrives first.

EXPLORE THE FACTORY AND COMPLETE THE SHOOT

Explore the dark, three-story factory from a first-person perspective. Find the locations needed for Junho's video and complete the shoot. Your flashlight battery is limited, and much of the building remains hidden in darkness.

FOLLOW THE TRACES LEFT BEHIND

Examine abandoned work areas, scattered documents, and traces of the people who once occupied the factory.

UNCOVER THE FACTORY'S SECRETS

Follow Junho's recording through the factory and uncover the secrets hidden within its abandoned spaces and scattered documents.

Unhistorical Warfare is the ultimate warfare sandbox. Muster armies from across the vast expanse of human history and watch them fight in real-time, under AI control or your direct command. Find out what happens when a Roman legion meets a Panzer IV, when a war elephant runs into a squad of Napoleonic grenadiers, or when medieval knights charge a Confederate line. 

31 armies, 480 BC to 1991

Every army is drawn from a real force at a real moment, with the troops it actually fielded:

  • Ancient: Achaemenid Persia, Macedon, Carthage, Rome, Gaul

  • Medieval: Tang China, the Norse, Byzantium, the Ayyubids, Jerusalem, the Mongols, the Empire, Scotland, England, France, the Teutonic Order

  • Gunpowder: the Ottomans, the Mexica, Sengoku Japan, the Spanish tercios

  • Black powder: the Continental Army, Napoleonic France, Britain, Imperial Russia, the Union, the Confederacy, the Zulu

  • WWII: the Wehrmacht, the Red Army,

  • Gulf War: the US Army, the Republican Guard

Sarissa phalanxes, longbowmen behind dug pits, schiltrons of Scottish spears, janissary matchlocks, redcoat volleys, rifled muskets, MG42s and 120mm tank guns all exist in the same simulation and all behave as they should.

Features

  • 30+ armies and roughly 200 unit types, each with era-appropriate weapons, armour and animation

  • Individually simulated soldiers with morale, fatigue of the line, flanking and routing

  • Pila, arrows, bolts, sling stones, matchlock balls, volley fire, round shot, tank shells, machine guns and magic, all modelled separately

  • Vehicles that crush infantry under their tracks, explode when killed and leave burnt-out wrecks

  • Ten battlefields with terrain that changes how the fight goes

  • Upgrades: five stages each of Experience, Weapons, Armour and Leadership, applied per unit. Make elites of history's greatest fighting forces!

  • Battles resolve in two to four minutes; a full after-action report tells you who killed whom

  • Five AI generals, from Hapless to Legendary, for the enemy or for your own army if you would rather watch.

Unorthodox Rules is a psychological mystery-comedy deduction adventure inspired by Ace Attorney and Liar Game — about reading people, exposing contradictions, and surviving unfair rule-based games.

You wake up inside a strange university with no memory, a head wound, and a masked referee forcing students into a series of twisted contests.

Each major chapter features a different deadly game, a different opponent, and a different set of rules to understand, exploit, and overturn.

Victory is not about luck.

Investigate your surroundings, question suspicious characters, collect clues, and piece together the hidden logic behind each game. Then use what you have learned to predict your opponents, manipulate the rules, expose their contradictions, and survive battles designed to make you lose.

The current demo introduces the core loop through a high-stakes game of rock-paper-scissors — the first of several unfair games in the full story.

Unorthodox Rules combines investigation, character-driven mystery, card-based deduction puzzles, contradiction-based reasoning, and high-stakes psychological battles.

Expect bluffing, hidden motives, ridiculous suspects, dramatic turnabouts, unfair rules, and opponents who are already convinced they have won.

Features:

- A story-driven mystery-comedy deduction adventure

- Inspired by Ace Attorney-style contradiction solving and Liar Game-style rule-based mind games

- Multiple deadly rule-based games across the full story

- Investigation, dialogue, and clue collection

- Card-based deduction and evidence puzzles

- Strategic mind games where rules matter more than luck

- Contradictions, hidden motives, and unreliable information

- Unfair rules that can be studied, exploited, and overturned

- A cast of suspicious, ridiculous, and dangerous characters

- Multiple ways to approach certain deductions and confrontations

Story

“We don’t control. We don’t contain. We don’t protect.” At least, that’s the official line.

“We’re just an insurance company under an anomaly response agency. We survey sites and assess the damage.” At least, that’s what we tell the public.

“Do not touch the anomaly. Do not touch the anomaly. Do not touch the anomaly.” Yes, yes, understood. But—uh-oh…

------

After an “unauthorized procedure,” you—Venn, an insurance adjuster—are assigned to a dangerous sector as punishment.

Before you go, you must pass through a simulation area and prove you can survive it.

By simulating the anomalies’ magnetic fields, the lab recreates their abilities: concealing information at a site and rewriting its rules.

The organization has thoughtfully assigned you a new partner. He never shows himself. Instead, he works with you through a mobile terminal—though he insists he’s right there at the scene.

It’s strange, but you let it go. In a place like this, who doesn’t have a secret?

------

Gradually, you begin to suspect that something is wrong with this “assessment.”

A fluorescent light flickers strangely when you touch it.

A device hidden beneath the floor of every room—one you never noticed before—can transport you to another room at any time.

In one room, mirrors hold the reflections of countless objects. Yet the reflections don’t quite match…

Just when you think it might all be over, you throw open a door expecting one final test. Instead, you find a scene of impossible calm: a Japanese dry garden, warm sunlight (aren’t you indoors?), and a tree…

You’re close to losing your mind. There is much more to this place than an assessment.

------

But the seemingly endless assessment goes on.

Your new partner, Milo, is young and reserved—just the sort of person you’d expect to find in this organization.

He has a remarkable gift: he can perceive the rules governing each scene. Making sense of those rules, and solving the anomalies’ fiendish puzzles, is up to you.

You can do this, Venn! Get through it all, whatever the organization is hiding.

Treat it like a game. Enjoy the moment. When it’s over, maybe they’ll even reward you. (Will they?)

How to Play

At heart, this is a Minesweeper game.

Left-click to explore a cell. Right-click to cycle its marker between anomaly, safe, and unmarked.

To complete a room, mark every anomaly, explore every safe cell, and submit your findings. A safe marker alone does not count as exploring a cell.

Every puzzle has a unique solution. The clues let you reason your way through without guessing.

Inspiration

Someone on our team made a game based on Sudoku. That led me to discover Murdoku, a logic puzzle that combines Sudoku with deduction, and I found it fascinating.

I’m not much of a Sudoku player myself. I prefer Minesweeper: each move gives you quicker feedback, and the reasoning tends to unfold in shorter steps. That’s more my speed.

So I started with a question: could I make a deduction game built around Minesweeper? I fell down that rabbit hole and kept going. While working out why every object’s position had to follow specific rules, I realized the idea fit the unsettling atmosphere of rules-based horror stories and the SCP Foundation. The notion that each room has its own set of laws also has a touch of the Backrooms. Those inspirations shaped the game into what it is today.

The more I work on this game, the more I realize how much there is to level design. I know what the demo currently offers still has plenty of room for improvement. I’ll keep refining it as best I can, improving the level structure and smoothing out the difficulty curve.

The levels in the demo are only the tip of the iceberg of what’s possible within the current set of mechanics.

I hope you enjoy it.

What’s Next

  • More rooms. I’ve built ten core areas, each centered on a different mechanic. They’re still being refined, especially the puzzles and how the difficulty builds from one room to the next.

  • Even more rooms. Combining those ten mechanics opens up new kinds of deductions. I want these puzzles to offer more than a longer or harder version of what came before.

  • Minigames and new NPCs. I’d like the cards you collect to have somewhere to be used, and to give you more reasons to engage with the world beyond solving rooms.

  • New kinds of anomalies—and new ways to play. Some anomalies have a very different effect on space and its rules. The puzzles they create will move beyond Minesweeper rather than simply adding more complications to the grid. This part is roughly halfway done.

  • A redesigned Route Panel. I’m considering a less linear way to choose where to go next. I hope it will make exploration more rewarding and allow for a more discovery-led puzzle structure inspired by The Witness.

  • No-Guess Mode. I plan to add a separate mode for players who want a more classic, old-school logic-puzzle experience, with the focus squarely on deduction.

  • And, of course, the least important item: more story fragments. I’d like to fill in the characters’ pasts and perhaps reveal a little more about the organization. Perhaps. Best not to get your hopes up.

—Onovich

In the 1990s, in a small border town in the Balkans, strange things and dangerous schemes are unfolding. The locals keep their secrets, hoping the truth never surfaces. But everything changes when Agent Bogomir is assigned to the border checkpoint - and, against his will, becomes a witness to every dirty secret and mystery shrouding the town. Now he must uncover what monster lies behind the primordial evil living within it.

Unreported Shift is a checkpoint inspection simulator, a psychological horror, wrapped in a dark yet warm atmosphere inspired by the works of David Lynch and the games of the PS1 era. We are Vetra, an indie studio, proud to present our debut and invite you to investigate a murder shrouded in a veil of mystery and horror, buried in an unassuming little town.

Inspect documents and bags. Sometimes you’ll find something unexpected. Sometimes something worse...

Watch for dates and names that don’t match, and check everything against the contraband list. Miss too much, and you won’t keep this job for long.

 

Talk to the people coming through. The kindest souls you’ll ever meet

...until you start asking questions.

Everyone here has a story, and a reason to cross the border. Whether those reasons are honest is another matter.

Who gets through is your call. But pay attention - everything has consequences.

Think for yourself, but stay within the law. Bones in a bag are strange, certainly. But is that any of your business?

Don’t forget to rest. Stop by Puzzo’s bar - you’ve earned a cold one!

Where the gossip gets traded, souls get poured out, and the truth floats to the top of the glass.

...And above all, stay alert. Something in this town is not right.

Designed to deeply immerse players in the protagonist's inner psyche through a first-person visual novel format. Moving beyond simple historical retelling, it densely captures the process in which "personal choices to protect a loved one" collide with or intertwine with the grand historical tide of the independence movement.

about_html:
Landing is just the beginning.

The engine is spluttering.

Fuel is running low.

Gravity, however, makes no effort whatsoever.

Welcome to Until somewhere, a challenging arcade game where every landing counts. Take control of your descent module, land with precision, collect upgrades for your ship… then head off a little further each time.

Because, at the end of the day, the best way to discover what lies in space is to survive it.

Simple gameplay… until it isn’t.

The concept is easy to grasp:

  • Fire up the thrusters.

  • Manage your fuel.

  • Avoid the mountains.

  • Try not to blow up.

Right from the start, the first landings are already tricky.

Then the platforms get smaller.

The terrain becomes more unpredictable.

Fuel is running low.

And every successful landing brings that little sense of satisfaction that makes you want to try ‘just one more planet’.

Repair, upgrade, try again.

Your ship isn’t ready for such a long journey.

After each expedition, collect parts and choose how to upgrade your module.

More thrust?

Greater stability?

A larger fuel tank?

Or perhaps a slightly more forgiving landing gear to desperately try and make things a bit easier?

Each improvement allows you to go a little further than the last.

A light-hearted adventure, but not without its mysteries.

You keep moving forward.

Ever further.

Planet after planet.

Why?

Good question.

Let’s just say that turning back was never really part of the plan.

Lina is with you.

Well…

She’s trying.

Between bits of piloting advice, a few well-aimed remarks and one or two minor disasters she refuses to take responsibility for, she’ll be your only company on the journey.

The silence of space is lovely.

But it’s even lovelier when someone’s there to comment on your crashes.

Features

  • Arcade-style landing gameplay that’s easy to pick up but challenging to master.

  • Gradually upgrade your ship to reach ever more distant areas.

  • Explore a series of planets generated as you progress.

  • Manage your thrust, speed and fuel to succeed in every approach.

  • Become the best. Or at least, one of the best...

  • A co-pilot who never misses an opportunity to comment on your exploits… or your mistakes.

  • A gameplay experience that blends challenge, exploration and lively banter.

  • Quick to pick up, hard to put down.

Used Car Dealer Simulator is a car trading and business simulation game where you buy used cars, inspect deals, negotiate prices, sell vehicles, and grow your own car dealership from a small lot into a successful auto business.

About This Game

Used Car Dealer Simulator puts you in charge of your own used car dealership. Start with a small car lot, search for profitable vehicles, buy low, sell high, and build your reputation as a smart car dealer.

Every car is an opportunity. Check the market, compare prices, prepare your vehicles for sale, and make the right deals to keep your business growing. From budget cars to more valuable rides, your goal is simple: turn used cars into profit.

Manage your dealership, improve your lot, attract customers, and become the go-to place for anyone looking to buy or sell a car.

Features

Buy and sell used cars
Find cars at the right price, add them to your dealership, and sell them for profit.

Run your own car dealership
Manage your car lot, organize your vehicles, and grow your business step by step.

Negotiate and make deals
Every sale matters. Choose the right price and try to get the best value from every customer.

Upgrade your business
Expand your dealership, improve your garage, and unlock better opportunities as you progress.

Car trading simulation
Experience the core loop of buying, pricing, selling, and scaling a used car business.

Daylight car lot atmosphere
Enjoy a bright, colorful dealership environment with cars, sale signs, and a classic auto business feeling.

Usurper is an incremental space shooter built around taking control of your enemies. Seize enemy ships, command their firepower, and turn their weapons to your advantage. Collect alloy in battle, research technology, and combine unit abilities as you grow strong enough to take on new sectors and bosses.

Seize Enemy Ships. Build Your Fleet.

Keep a target within capture range to gradually take control of it. Ships that once hunted you turn blue and join the fleet orbiting around you. Let Gunners keep firing, Wardens intercept projectiles, and Carriers launch attack craft. Build your own fleet from the enemy's ranks.

Keep Their Support or Unleash Their Abilities?

Controlled units can stay in formation to support you, or be activated to unleash their individual abilities. Launch a Dart, sweep through nearby enemies, charge your way out of danger, or drop bombs on a target.

Activation consumes a unit or one of its remaining uses. You decide which units to keep fighting at your side and which to spend on a breakthrough.

Research Technology. Make Your Units Work Together.

Invest the alloy you earn in the tech tree to capture enemies more efficiently, expand your formation, and improve each unit type's attacks and abilities. Unlock synergies between units and new ways to fight.

Even if a sortie ends in defeat, you keep the alloy you've earned and the research you've completed. Pick up the upgrades you need and try again.

Unlock New Forms and Wield Their Abilities Yourself

Defeat the corresponding bosses to unlock 11 specialized forms. Continuously sweep through nearby enemies, launch your own charges, or become a Carrier and send out attack craft.

Choose your ship's form and starting unit separately before each sortie. Combine them with the units you capture in battle to try different mixes of offense and support.

Fight Through 8 Sectors and Break Their Bosses' Defenses

From armored machines to towering fortresses with mechanical arms and carriers that keep launching squadrons, each sector has a different boss waiting to challenge you.

Dodge attacks, destroy components, and find openings. Use captured units to counter each boss's attacks and defenses. With stronger firepower from research and the right use of unit abilities, defenses that once held you back begin to crumble.

Finish the Campaign. Continue the Conquest.

After completing the campaign, enter Endless Conquest to face increasingly powerful enemy waves and bosses, and continue researching endgame technologies.

Unlock form shifting to change mid-battle into your selected unit's corresponding form, provided you've already unlocked it. Research Nuclear Shift to trigger a wide-area blast when you transform. Put endgame technology to work for you.

Key Features

  • Capture enemy ships and turn them into your fleet.
  • Command 11 unit types and mix their firepower and abilities.
  • Fight through 8 sectors and their bosses. Learn their mechanics and break through their defenses.
  • In fast-paced battles, keep units for support or activate their abilities to break out of danger.
  • Research technology and unlock new forms. Keep your alloy and research progress even after defeat.
  • Enter Endless Conquest after completing the campaign and research endgame technologies.

TURN RHYTHM INTO FIREPOWER

VECTORHYTHM is a neon bullet heaven where your timing turns a weapon build into screen-clearing firepower.

Move freely. Aim freely. You choose when to attack. Your attacks are graded against the music: accurate timing charges Power, strengthens your weapons and builds the momentum to tear through the swarm.

Miss a beat and that momentum fades, but the next beat is always a chance to take it back.

The rhythm does not tell you where to move. It determines how hard you hit.

BUILD THE SPECTACLE

Choose a loadout, then shape each Survivors run through a branching skill tree. Combine:

  • Primary, Secondary and beat-powered weapons.
  • Defensive fields, shields and evasive abilities.
  • Passive upgrades that transform your damage, reach and survivability.
  • Weapon evolutions and powerful one-off attacks.

Commit to one weapon line or combine several systems. Beams split, projectiles multiply, defensive fields expand and carefully chosen upgrades grow into a build that can hold back the whole screen.

Build the loadout of a bullet heaven. Earn its full power by staying in the groove.

THE ENEMY HEARS IT TOO

Every track sets the pace, palette and pressure of the fight. Enemies fire on the beat, hazards land with the music and nine bosses turn the rhythm into distinct, readable attack patterns.

Across 26 bundled tracks, layered neon arenas pulse and shift behind faceted enemy silhouettes, dimensional weapon effects and explosive impacts designed to keep even the busiest battles readable.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

ARCADE MODE is a quick, song-length score attack. Choose a track, master a fixed loadout, collect power-ups and one-off weapons, then chase your best grade and a place on the leaderboard.

SURVIVORS MODE gives your build room to grow. Choose a loadout and playlist, draft upgrades as you level and survive escalating stages, hazards and bosses. Bank Shards for permanent upgrades and new Hangar cosmetics between runs.

MASTER THE RUN

You do not need perfect rhythm to start. Five difficulty levels run from Relaxed to Overload: lower levels widen the timing windows and leave more room to breathe, while higher levels tighten the beat, bring tougher enemy combinations and reward bigger scores.

Start where you feel comfortable. Move up when you are ready for the rhythm to fight back.

FEATURES

  • Free twin-stick movement with attacks you time yourself.
  • Perfect, Good and Mistimed grades that directly affect combat power.
  • Quick Arcade score runs and longer, build-driven Survivors runs.
  • A branching skill tree with weapon evolutions, passives, defense and movement abilities.
  • 26 bundled tracks with music-driven combat and distinct visual themes.
  • 36 enemy types, including nine beat-choreographed bosses.
  • Five difficulty levels, from forgiving timing to high-score pressure.
  • Full controller support, remappable controls and dedicated Steam Deck tuning.
  • Steam achievements, leaderboards and Cloud saves.
  • Interface localization in ten languages.

Shoot to the beat. Break the swarm.

Play the free demo. If the beat clicks, wishlist VECTORHYTHM.

about_html:
SEE IT CHARGE. BREAK IT.

VEKARRA is a turn-based dark-fantasy party roguelite. Time stops when you choose. Most enemy attacks charge on the Active Time Battle clock, so you see the killing blow coming and can draft the skills to interrupt it.

ALONE OR TOGETHER

Lead four heroes alone, or split the party with a friend: one four-hero party, two heroes each.

  • Free demo: Act 1, solo or two-player local co-op.
  • Early Access (planned for Q4 2026): online co-op for two.
  • 1.0 full release (planned): co-op for up to four players and PvP, online and local, including the ranked Arena.

THE BUILD IS THE RUN

  • Draft skills after victories and raise them from one to three stars at camp.
  • No experience levels, no mana: powerful skills run on cooldown cycles.
  • Buy relics and supplies, and adapt to seven tactical aspects.

EVERY DESCENT HAS A PRICE

Seeded maps of battles, elites, camps, shops, treasure, narrative events and biome bosses. A fallen hero leaves the company unless you pay to bring them back. Lose all four and the expedition ends; permanent unlocks widen your next start.

AN ABYSS THAT KEEPS ACCOUNTS

Beneath the fishing island of Vekarra, mines and pilgrim caves open into the Abyss: a wound with a hunger and a ledger. Every route, draft and corpse changes the run.

EARLY ACCESS

Early Access is planned to cover the first half of the descent: Acts 1 and 2 of 4 and their two bosses. The campaign stops after Act 2, cannot be completed in this version, and continues in 1.0. Plans may change with testing and feedback.

The hordes are gathering. How long can you survive?

VERAKORIA is a pixel-art action roguelite where you battle relentless waves of enemies, grow stronger with every level, and create a new build during each run.

Move across the battlefield, collect experience, choose powerful upgrades, and prepare to face increasingly dangerous enemy phases and deadly bosses.

Choose Your Race and Class


Create your fighter by combining one of four races with one of four distinct classes. Choose between Human, Demon, Skeleton, or Lizard, then enter the battlefield as a Knight, Archer, Wizard, or Priest.

Each race provides a different passive advantage, while every class has its own combat style and signature ability. Experiment with different combinations and discover the build that best suits your playstyle.

Build Your Arsenal


Level up during each run and choose from a variety of upgrades. Improve your combat stats, strengthen your class ability, or unlock additional weapons such as spinning axes, piercing spears, and waves of cursed skull flames.

Every decision shapes your build. Focus on raw damage, attack speed, or survivability or combine multiple weapons to take control of the battlefield.

Survive the Horde


The battle becomes more dangerous as time passes. New enemy types enter the field, the hordes grow larger, and powerful bosses stand between you and survival.

Keep moving, collect experience dropped by fallen enemies, open treasure chests, and adapt your strategy before the horde overwhelms you.

Key Features


  • Fast-paced horde-survival combat
  • Four playable races with unique passive abilities
  • Four distinct classes: Knight, Archer, Wizard, and Priest
  • Multiple weapons and upgrade paths
  • Escalating enemy phases and boss encounters
  • Different race and class combinations to experiment with
  • Pixel-art visuals and an atmospheric soundtrack
  • Steam achievements to unlock

Choose your fighter. Create your build. Face the horde.

Welcome to VERAKORIA.

Overview

Only what the light touches changes its shape.

VIGNETTE is a first-person point-and-click psychological horror about light and perception.

Shining the Light

Flashlight in hand, you move through a space gone silent.

In this world, the beam is what keeps "something" at bay.

What appears when you shine the light.

What disappears when you shine the light.

And what does not exist unless you do.

As you go deeper, the structure of this world shifts, until it is no longer what it was.

She Is Still, Perfectly Normal.

This is not merely an escape.

What are you looking at?

And what will you come to know?

A Quieter Fear

There are no jump scares.

Nothing leaps out. What you've seen simply doesn't go away.

Gather clues, think carefully — and whether to shine the light is up to you.

Demo

A free demo is available now. It takes about 20 minutes.

Interface and subtitles in Japanese, English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Korean, Thai, Russian, and Belarusian.

*Screenshots are from a work in progress and may differ from the final version.

A critical emergency has erupted inside a sealed research facility, transforming trainees and personnel into violent mutants. Fight through the lockdown, protect your team, and uncover the truth behind the outbreak.

VIRSTEX ENDSTRAIN is a fast-paced 2D side-scrolling run-and-gun built around responsive movement and multidirectional combat.

・Aim and fire in eight directions
・Run, jump, dash, crouch, climb, and hang from overhead structures
・Block frontal attacks with a shield
・Break through enemy groups with smart bombs and a heavy machete
・Fight infected enemies and multi-phase bosses
・Replay missions, improve completion times, and upgrade weapons
・Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese text support

■あらすじ

初めてのソロライブ。絶対に最高のライブにしてみせる――！

VTuber事務所のマネージャー・楠木若葉は、

担当タレント・月宮エリカ（如月美玲）のサポートに徹していた。

渋谷の街頭ビジョンに流れる、15秒の応援広告。

『私の歌が、次元を超える』

配信のトラブル、伸びない同時接続、素直じゃない美玲の軽口。

ライブまで、あと6日。

「絶対、最高のライブにしましょう」

これは、マネージャーとタレントの、“最高のライブ”までの6日間の物語。

……そのはず、だった。

■遊び方

テキストアドベンチャーです。

画面をクリックしてストーリーを進めていきます。

ストーリーの途中で選択肢が表示され、プレイヤーの選択によってストーリーが分岐します。

■ゲーム仕様

ジャンル：ビジュアルノベルゲーム

プレイ時間：6時間～8時間

イベントCG：20枚

オープニングソング：あり

企画/ディレクション：縹
シナリオ：伴坂

キャラクターデザイン：緜/wata
原画：緜/wata , Cthlo
UI/UXデザイン：RedForestDesigning

音楽：kolorincho ,Keica* ,432

CAST

月宮エリカ/如月美玲：吉村 汐里

日向きらら/白瀬煌：樋上 渚紗

小柳ほのか：柊 優花

中村理斗：菅野 一

主題歌

「Aftersounds」phrilli

作詞:Yuto Iizuka

作曲:Yuto Iizuka

Story

One day, Akim, a short-faced tiger, wakes up deep inside a cave. He rouses Leelee, a long-faced panda sleeping beside him, and they step outside — only to find that 10,000 years have passed.

The land is now ruled by Very Long Yama, once a trusted friend, who for reasons unknown governs the medieval Very Long Kingdom with an iron fist. Unable to stand his tyranny, Akim and Leelee set out to free their sealed companions, recover their lost memories, and uncover the mystery of the 10,000 years.

Features

Switch Characters for Varied Action

A metroidvania-style 2D action game where you switch between unique heroes to fit the situation.

  • Akim: Collect Rainbow Seeds to transform from Very Short to Very Long form, greatly boosting attack power

  • Leelee: A high-HP brawler who fights with his fists. Short range but steady damage even at low attack levels, with punches that pierce enemies and walls

  • Orochi: Poison attacks that halve enemy movement speed for a time

  • Mitama: Floats in midair and strikes from afar with will-o'-the-wisps — tricky to control, but powerful

Grow Stronger by Recovering Memories

The heroes lost their memories during their 10,000-year seal. Each memory recovered raises their HP. Rainbow Seeds dropped by enemies raise your attack level — but taking damage lowers it, keeping every fight tense.

Quirky Bosses

Your former comrades, now controlled by seeds of darkness, stand in your way as bosses. They look goofy, but they are surprisingly tough.

Varied Stages

Explore caves, forests, an eerie haunted castle, and a very long tower — a world drawn in beautiful pixel art, full of small puzzles to solve.

Playtime

4–8 hours to complete.
